page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, configured with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge exhibits modest compute capabilities. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 10% to 25% tier. Memory read bandwidth is also relatively low, with small block cached reads at 328.42 GB/sec and large block uncached reads at 39.24 GB/sec falling into the bottom 25%. However, large block uncached memory write performance is average at 34.3 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests achieve average ratings, while database operations, Redis SET performance, and static web serving throughput remain in the bottom 25%.

Given its high memory density paired with lower-tier CPU performance, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high-frequency processing power. It is suitable for caching layers, light database operations, and memory-bound applications where RAM capacity is the primary constraint rather than raw compute throughput. It is less suited for high-throughput web serving, heavy cryptography, or intensive LLM inference tasks.
